paite: Huan Philistia mite'n Pathian bawm ala ua, Ebenezer a pan Ashdod ah apaipih uhi.
heading: Philistiate Lak Ah Thukhun Bawm

paite: Philistia mite'n Pathian bawm ala ua, Dagon inn ah alalut ua, Dagon kiang ah akoih uhi.
Ashdod khomite zingkhangpi a athoh uleh, ngai in, TOUPA bawm ma ah Dagon amai a lei si in ana puk vialvual mawk hi. Dagon ala ua, a-omna mun ah akoih nawn uhi.
Azing nawn zingkhangpi a athoh uleh, ngai in, TOUPA bawm ma ah Dagon amai a lei si in ana puk vialvual mawk a; Dagon lu leh akhutpek bawm langnih kitankhia kongpi bul ah ana kikham hi.
Huaiziak in Dagon siampu hiam, Dagon inn a hong paite'n leng Ashdod a Dagon inn bul tuni tan in asik ngam kei uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA khut Ashdod khua mite tung ah agik a, amaute ahihsia a, Ashdod khua leh akiang vel a omte zaangtan hipi in agawtta hi.
Huchi in Ashdod a mite'n huchibang thil tung amuh un, "Israelte' Pathian bawm i kiang uah om gige kei hen, eimah leh i pathian Dagon tung ah akhut khak ana tel mai," achi uhi.

Huaiziak in Philistia hausa tengteng akiang uah asamkhawm ua, "Israelte' Pathian bawm bang i lohta dia?" achi uh. Amau, "Israelte' Pathian bawm Gath ah puak hi hen," chi in adawng uhi. Huchi in Gath ah Israelte' Pathian bawm apaipihta uhi.
Hichi ahong hi a, apaipih lai un TOUPA khut in huai khua ahihseta hi. Kho mite aneu leh alian agawt vek a, atung uah zaangtan hipi alengsak hi.
Huchi in Pathian bawm Ekron ah atun ua, Ekron khomite'n Israelte Pathian bawm eite leh i mite that ding in i kiang ahon tunta uh, chi in akikou vengvung uhi.

Huchi in Philistia hausa tengteng asamkhawm ua, "Israelte' Pathian bawm paimangsak unla, koute leh ka mite ahon thahlouhna ding in a-omna mun ngei ah pai nawn hen," achi uh. Kho pumpi ah sihna khop siatna a-om a; Pathian khut lah huai khua ah agik mahmah ngal a.
Asiloute'n zaangtan avei chiat ua, van ah huai kho kikou husa atungtou hi.
